english.note: This is the all-purpose verb phrase for saying that someone feels or suffers pain.
Use this when “suffer” specifically means experiencing physical pain.

examples.english: I have a bit of an ache in my head.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 go3 tau4 jau5 di1 tung3

examples.english: I suffer pain when I get an injection.
examples.jyutping: daa2 zam1 go2 zan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 tung3
